title: 3 Ways to Get More Orders on Your Shopify Store #Shorts
description:
Full product page walkthrough: https://youtu.be/t5Jp2uJoICc

Three built-in ways to get more orders on a Shopify store: gift wrap, product bundles, and a cart that keeps suggesting what to add. All of them come with Fuse, a Shopify theme by UTD on the official Shopify Theme Store.

Try Fuse free: https://themes.shopify.com/themes/fuse?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=fuse-pdp-short

Voiceover generated with AI. Video shows screen recordings of the live Fuse demo store.
